Description[3101381]: Program for the Grinnell College Department of Theatre and Dance's Midwest premiere production of Elinor Cook's play 'Image of an Unknown Young Woman,' directed by Lesley Delmenico. The play explores the impact of viral images, media manipulation, protest, and ethical ambiguity, set in an unnamed city reminiscent of the Middle East. The program includes cast and crew lists, director's notes, production credits, and information about related events and acknowledgments.
